title: Eye Dryness Evaluation in Primary Sjögren's Syndrome
brief_summary: The objective of this observational study is to develop new tools to assess primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) symptoms and to measure the severity of eye involvement in these patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of pSS according to ACR/EULAR classification criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient does not possess a smartphone with web connection
* patient unable to sign an informed consent
study_population: Consecutive pSS patients seen in Rheumatology
